title: Advance with a Sense of Purpose: The Law of Aimlessness
coreMove: Distinguish true purpose from borrowed or false missions by tracking sustained energy, refinement, and sacrifice over time.
sourcePressure: This law presents purpose as an organizing force that emerges through work, refinement, and recognition of one's strongest line, not instant destiny.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning purpose into inspirational destiny language instead of developmental direction built through work.
